voiceSummary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 post results earnings call held on November 4, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenues of ₹79.1 billion, up 29% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at ₹18.9 billion with a margin of 24%. Net profit was ₹9.3 billion. The net debt to EBITDA ratio was 0.62 times as on September 30, 2026. India branded formulations grew 19% year-on-year. International markets formulations revenues were ₹10 billion, up 33% year-on-year. US revenues reached ₹33.1 billion, up 21% year-on-year. Consumer wellness revenues were ₹11.2 billion, up 76% year-on-year. Medical devices revenues were ₹2.2 billion. The company received USFDA acceptance for the BLA for a Keytruda biosimilar. Phase IIb trial results for Saroglitazar in MASH were positive. The company is investing in the US launch of Saroglitazar.

voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited acquired 38,222 equity shares in Creative Port Development Private Limited on November 7, 2026. This acquisition resulted from the conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. The conversion ratio was one equity share for every 65.69 preference shares. Tata Steel’s equity stake in the subsidiary increased from 51% to 57.5%. The company received a cash payment of ₹6,876.11 for fractional entitlements. Creative Port Development Private Limited remains a subsidiary of Tata Steel. The target entity operates in the transportation and storage sector. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

voiceSummary: Amber Enterprises India Limited intimates that its material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics India Limited, filed the Draft Red Herring Prospectus on 7th November 2026 with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, BSE Limited, and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. This filing relates to the proposed Initial Public Offer of IL JIN Electronics India Limited. The IPO is subject to receipt of required regulatory approvals. The intimation was made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The information is available on the company website at www.ambergroupindia.com.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed the acquisition of the balance 40% equity stake of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited ("Power-One") from Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Venna, shareholders of Power-One, pursuant to Share Swap agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Power-One a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A3 have been allotted by IL JIN to Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Veena, as a non -cash consideration, for the aforesaid, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed acquisition of the balance 1.50% equity stake of Ascent Circuits Private Limited ("Ascent Circuits"), from Ms. Manju Thomas, shareholder of Ascent Circuits, pursuant to Share Swap Agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Ascent Circuits Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A2 have been allotted by IL JIN to Ms. Manju Thomas, as non-cash consideration, for the aforesaid acquisition, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.

Upon completion of the aforesaid transaction, Power-One shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.
